name: Vaibhav Bajpai
tagline: I build production GenAI systems — RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, and LLM evaluation on AWS Bedrock — plus the React, Node.js, and cloud-native full-stack platforms around them.
bio: I'm a GenAI and Full-Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience building production AI applications and the web platforms around them. I specialize in RAG systems, LLM evaluation, and multi-agent architectures using LangChain, LangGraph, and AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker), with delivered results including 60% faster drug discovery workflows and 70% faster document processing. On the full-stack side I build with React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, with secure REST APIs, role-based access control, and event-driven, cloud-native architectures. I enjoy taking products from concept to deployment with clean architecture.
